payload.title: A Death Before Its Time
payload.prompt: The paper bears tomorrow's date. Tomas answers you in person at 18:00. The edition register says tomorrow's press run starts at 04:00. Which two records prove this notice was planted before the legitimate edition?
payload.summary: The paper bears tomorrow's date. Tomas answers you in person at 18:00. The edition register says tomorrow's press run starts at 04:00. Which two records prove this notice was planted before the legitimate edition?

items.label: Press register: 04:00 tomorrow
items.description: The legitimate edition has not been printed.

hints: A future date alone does not prove a forgery.
Compare something observed now with the legitimate production schedule.
Use Tomas's appearance and the press register together.

payload.title: Confirmed: An Unauthorized Printing
payload.summary: Tomas is alive, and the real edition has not run. Someone printed the death notice separately.

payload.title: Which Lead First?: Interview the compositor

Which Lead First?
payload.prompt: Ada can take you to the compositor, or you can examine the distribution ledger. These approaches expose different evidence.

payload.title: The Ink on His Sleeve
payload.prompt: Nico says he never touched the notice. His sleeve has violet ink; the job ticket calls for black; a locked violet press was opened with his signed key receipt. Present the receipt that checks his claim.
payload.summary: Nico admits taking a print order from Inspector Orsini, but says the threatened witness was Ada.
hints: Separate each witness claim from the evidence that can check it.
Compare the stated constraints before choosing an arrangement.

payload.title: The Parcel That Came Back
payload.prompt: The ledger timestamps are explicit: a plate left the press at 16:00, the false notice arrived at Tomas's shop at 17:00, and its courier returned a signed receipt at 17:20. Arrange those events.
payload.summary: The returning receipt bears Inspector Orsini's office stamp; the delivery was a warning intended to provoke Ada.

payload.title: Nico's Account

payload.title: Stamped Return Receipt
